_comment: Octail's own egg (plan §6.4): a Bun app such as a Discord bot, TypeScript run as it is, from a git repository or uploaded. The install only fetches the code (installer image, git); dependencies are installed with bun install at start, as the server's own user. Nothing is pulled unless the owner sets a repository and turns Auto Update on; a private repository's token travels as an HTTP header in git's environment, never in .git/config or the printed startup line.
name: Bun App
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Any JavaScript or TypeScript app run with Bun: Discord and Telegram bots, small web services and APIs. Install from a git repository (public, or private with a token) or upload the files. Dependencies are installed with bun install when the app starts; it runs with bun run <main file> or the start script.

startup_commands.Default:
if [ -n "${GIT_REPO}" ] && [ "${AUTO_UPDATE}" = 1 ] && [ -d .git ]; then echo '[Octail] Auto Update: pulling the latest code'; GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=${GIT_TOKEN:+1} GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraHeader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}" "$GIT_TOKEN" | base64 -w0)" git pull -q --ff-only || echo '[Octail] git pull failed: starting the code that is already here'; fi; if [ -f package.json ] && { [ "${INSTALL_DEPS}" = always ] || { [ "${INSTALL_DEPS}" = auto ] && { [ ! -f node_modules/.octail-installed ] || [ package.json -nt node_modules/.octail-installed ] || [ bun.lock -nt node_modules/.octail-installed ] || [ bun.lockb -nt node_modules/.octail-installed ] || [ "$(cat node_modules/.octail-installed)" != "$(bun --version)" ]; }; }; }; then echo '[Octail] Installing dependencies'; if [ -f bun.lock ] || [ -f bun.lockb ]; then bun install --frozen-lockfile; else bun install; fi || exit 1; mkdir -p node_modules; bun --version > node_modules/.octail-installed; fi; if [ "${START_MODE}" = file ] && [ ! -f "${MAIN_FILE}" ]; then echo "[Octail] ${MAIN_FILE} wasn't found: upload the app, or set Git Repository and reinstall"; exit 1; fi; octail_app() { if [ "${START_MODE}" = bun-start ]; then bun run start ${APP_ARGS}; else bun run ${BUN_ARGS} "${MAIN_FILE}" ${APP_ARGS}; fi; }; if [ -z "${READY_TEXT}" ]; then printf '[Octail] App is %s
' running; octail_app; else set -o pipefail; octail_app 2>&1 | { while IFS= read -r l || [ -n "$l" ]; do printf '%s
' "$l"; case "$l" in *"${READY_TEXT}"*) printf '[Octail] App is %s
' running; break;; esac; done; exec cat; }; fi

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Octail Bun app install: fetches the app from its git repository when one is set (Git Repository on the
# Startup tab); without one the server stays empty for an upload. Dependencies are installed when the
# server starts (bun install), as the server's own user.
# Reinstalling resets the files git tracks to the branch; untracked files (.env, databases, uploads) stay.
#
# Server Files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GIT_REPO:-}" ]; then
    echo "No git repository set: upload your app with the file manager or SFTP, then start the server."
    exit 0
fi
case "${GIT_REPO}" in
    https://*) ;;
    *)
        echo "Installation failed: Git Repository must be an https:// address."
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0
git config --global --add safe.directory /mnt/server
git config --global init.defaultBranch main
if [ -n "${GIT_TOKEN:-}" ]; then
    # Private repositories: HTTP basic auth with the token (GitHub, GitLab, Gitea, Bitbucket app passwords).
    GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0="Authorization: Basic $(printf '%s:%s' "${GIT_USERNAME:-x-access-token}" "${GIT_TOKEN}" | base64 -w0)"
    export GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=http.extraHeader GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0
fi

[ -d .git ] || git init -q
if git remote get-url origin > /dev/null 2>&1; then
    git remote set-url origin "${GIT_REPO}"
else
    git remote add origin "${GIT_REPO}"
fi

BRANCH="${GIT_BRANCH:-}"
if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
    BRANCH=$(git ls-remote --symref origin HEAD | sed -n 's|^ref: refs/heads/\(.*\)\tHEAD$|\1|p') || true
    if [ -z "${BRANCH}" ]; then
        echo "Installation failed: ${GIT_REPO} couldn't be read (a wrong address, or a private repository without a token)."
        exit 1
    fi
fi

echo "Fetching ${GIT_REPO}, branch ${BRANCH}"
if ! git fetch -q --depth 1 origin "+refs/heads/${BRANCH}:refs/remotes/origin/${BRANCH}"; then
    echo "Installation failed: branch ${BRANCH} of ${GIT_REPO} couldn't be fetched."
    exit 1
fi
git checkout -q -f -B "${BRANCH}" "origin/${BRANCH}"
git branch -q --set-upstream-to="origin/${BRANCH}" "${BRANCH}"

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed: $(git log -1 --format='%h %s')"
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: The app's git repository as an https:// address (https://github.com/you/your-bot), fetched by the install. Empty: upload the app yourself. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: The branch to install and pull. Empty: the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Only for private repositories: the account the token belongs to. Empty works for GitHub tokens.

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Only for private repositories: a read-only access token (GitHub: a fine-grained token with Contents read). Never written to the server folder or the console.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: 1: pull the newest commit of the branch at every start (git pull --ff-only; a failed pull starts the code already there). 0: only Reinstall updates the code.

variables.name: Start With
variables.description: file: bun run <Main File>. bun-start: the start script of package.json (bun run start).

variables.name: Main File
variables.description: The file bun runs (Start With: file), relative to the server folder: index.ts, src/bot.ts, index.js. TypeScript runs without a build step.

variables.name: Install Dependencies
variables.description: auto: bun install (--frozen-lockfile with a bun.lock) when package.json or the lock file changed, or the Bun version did. always: at every start. never: you manage node_modules.

variables.name: Bun Options
variables.description: Extra bun flags before the main file, such as --smol (less memory) or --env-file=.env.production.

variables.name: App Arguments
variables.description: Extra arguments passed to the app, split at spaces.

variables.name: Ready Text
variables.description: Console text that means the app is up, such as 'Logged in as'. The server shows Running once a line contains it (or once the app listens on the main port). Empty: Running as soon as the app starts.
